library(shiny)

shinyServer(function(input, output, session) 
{
  data <- reactive({
      infile <- input$file1
      if (is.null(input$file1)) {return(NULL)}
      risk <- read.csv(infile$datapath)
  })
  output$datam <- renderTable({data()})
  output$depvar <- renderUI(
    {
      numsa <- as.list(names(data()[sapply(data(), is.numeric)]))
      selectInput('depv','Dependent Variable',numsa)
    })
  output$indvar <- renderUI(
    {
      numsa <- as.list(names(data()[sapply(data(), is.numeric)]))
      selectInput("indv","independent Var", numsa, multiple=TRUE, selectize=TRUE)
    })
  regr <- reactive(
    {
      datam <- data()
      reg <- lm(as.formula(paste(input$depv,"~",paste(input$indv,collapse="="))),datam)
    })
  output$regr <- renderTable({
    summary(regr())$coefficients
  })
  })
